products.name: Bismillah Gold-Leaf Calligraphy Canvas
products.short: Hand-lettered in gold leaf on deep emerald canvas.
products.description: Each stroke of this Bismillah is lettered by hand, then gilded with imitation gold leaf and sealed to keep its glow. Stretched on a solid pine frame, ready to hang. Choose your size, or ask us for different wording.

products.name: Ayat al-Kursi Round Canvas
products.short: A 60 cm roundel with a gilded kintsugi seam.
products.description: A circular canvas lettered with Ayat al-Kursi, framed by a hand-painted gold border. One of a series of five; this edition will not be repeated.

products.name: Personalised Name Canvas, Arabic & English
products.short: Your name in Arabic calligraphy and English script, framed in leaves.
products.description: Send us a name and we letter it twice: once in flowing Arabic, once in English, framed with hand-painted leaves. Perfect for a nursery, a new home, or a couple's names on their wedding day. We send a proof on WhatsApp before we paint.

products.name: Emerald Tide Resin Tray
products.short: Poured resin in emerald and pearl, edged with gold.
products.description: Layers of emerald, teal and pearl resin poured and torched by hand to form ocean lacing, then finished with a hand-gilded rim. Food-safe top coat. Every pour is one of a kind.

products.name: Kintsugi Resin Coasters, Set of 4
products.short: Ivory resin with gold veins, inspired by kintsugi.
products.description: Four 10 cm coasters in milky ivory resin with gold seams running through, like a bowl mended with gold. Cork-backed and gift-boxed.

products.name: Nikah Pen with Gold Nib & Florals
products.short: Hand-painted pen with your names and nikah date.
products.description: An emerald pen hand-painted with tiny florals and finished with the couple's names and nikah date in gold. Arrives in a velvet-lined box, ready for the signing.

products.name: Nikah Pen & Certificate Tray Set
products.short: Resin tray, matching pen pair and certificate folder.
products.description: A coordinated set for the nikah table: a resin tray in your wedding colours, two hand-painted pens and a gold-edged certificate folder, all lettered with your names.

products.name: Wedding Trousseau Hamper, Emerald Box
products.short: A velvet trousseau box, filled and lettered for the bride.
products.description: Our signature emerald trousseau box with a hand-lettered lid, filled with a name canvas, a custom diary, dried roses and a handwritten letter from you. Every detail can be tailored.

products.name: Anniversary Keepsake Hamper
products.short: A memory box with your date, your song and a letter.
products.description: A linen box holding a mini canvas of your wedding date, a resin keepsake with a pressed flower, a handwritten letter and chocolates. Tell us your story and we'll letter it in.

products.name: Birthday Bloom Hamper
products.short: Flowers, a name card and small treats. Same-day in Hyderabad.
products.description: A cheerful box with a dried-flower posy, a hand-painted name card, a scented candle and treats. Same-day delivery across Hyderabad when ordered before 2 pm.

products.name: Custom Diary with Gold-Foil Initials
products.short: Linen-bound A5 diary, hand-foiled with a name or initials.
products.description: A5, 200 pages of cream paper, lay-flat binding. We hand-foil up to 14 characters on the cover and paint a small botanical on the first page.

products.name: Handwritten Letter, Wax-Sealed
products.short: Your words, written by hand in ink and sealed in gold wax.
products.description: You write it, we pen it: your message handwritten in ink on textured paper, folded into a lined envelope and sealed with gold wax. Up to 250 words.

products.name: Dried Flower Bouquet
products.short: Everlasting blooms wrapped in cream paper and silk ribbon.
products.description: Bunny tails, dried roses and pampas in soft ivory and sage, wrapped by hand. Lasts for years.

products.name: Hand-painted Greeting Card
products.short: A small watercolour card with your message inside.
products.description: Every card is painted individually, so no two are the same. We write your message inside in ink.

products.name: Eid Mubarak Gift Box
products.short: Dates, attar and a mini calligraphy canvas in an emerald box.
products.description: Medjool dates, a small attar, a 10 × 10 cm calligraphy canvas and an Eidi envelope with the recipient's name in gold.

products.name: Diwali Diya & Resin Platter
products.short: A gilded resin platter with four hand-painted diyas.
products.description: A 30 cm resin platter in ivory and gold, with four clay diyas painted by hand. Makes a lovely puja thali or table centrepiece.

products.name: Corporate Desk Set: Resin Pen Stand & Diary
products.short: Resin pen stand and foiled diary in your brand colours.
products.description: A resin pen stand poured in your brand colours, with a matching diary foiled with your logo. Minimum 25 sets; see Corporate Gifting for bulk pricing.

products.name: Mended Garden, Original Canvas 60 × 90
products.short: An original acrylic on canvas, crossed with gold-leaf seams.
products.description: Layered emerald, sage and cream acrylic with textured palette-knife work and gold-leaf seams. Signed on the back. One original, never reproduced.
